verdict.rationale: The guidance page at justica.gov.pt was quoted extensively: authentication options, foreign-founder path, exact fees and process steps. That suggests its text is readable without login or keys, but no probe confirms it was fetched with an identified agent user agent and served as server-rendered HTML without a bot wall or CAPTCHA. The published eportugal.gov.pt Empresa Online entry URL returns HTTP 404, so an agent following the official entry path hits a dead end before finding the working guidance. Missing for 10: a hands-on probe of justica.gov.pt showing HTTP 200 to an identified agent UA, confirmation that content is not a JS-only shell and has no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, and a working published entry path on eportugal.gov.pt.
